clips.title: The story
paras: The Undercroft is an ancient burial crypt nestled in the southwestern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a dignified tomb of Lordaeron, it has been desecrated by a band of undead trolls under the command of Zaeldarr the Outcast. Amid the defiled catacombs lies an ersatz grave dug long ago to feign the death of the exiled paladin Tirion Fordring.

Carved into the rugged bluffs southwest of Corin's Crossing, the Undercroft was originally built as a final resting place for the honored dead of Lordaeron. The fall of the kingdom stripped away its sanctity, and the tomb is now infested by a band of savage undead trolls. Led by the hulking monstrosity Zaeldarr the Outcast, these ghoulish marauders use the underground halls as a redoubt from which to stalk the Plaguelands, even daring to raid the grave pits of Light's Hope Chapel to gather raw corpses for their sinister practices.
